notes.title: Closed Beta Start is HERE!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello There![/h2] 

[h2]The wait is over. Our Closed Beta has officially begun, and we could not be more excited to share this stage of the journey with you.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531909/7ba8ee719bfed99d34139f13f98cdd579eec64c2.png[/img]

This is your chance to jump into an early version of Neon Overdrive, explore the game before anyone else, and share your thoughts with us. Your feedback will directly shape the improvements we make as we move toward release.

[b]We would love for you to be part of it. If you are interested, sign up through the form below:[/b]
https://forms.gle/rwn8iKRK7csu9uwVA

Thank you for supporting Neon Overdrive and helping us take this next step. We cannot wait to hear your thoughts and see you in the Closed Beta.

[i][b]~The Neon Overdrive Team[/b][/i]

notes.title: Devlog - Gamescom
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey there, Neons![/b][/h2]

[h2]In today’s devlog, we want to share some insights about our development journey that leads us to the upcoming Gamescom! Let’s jump right in![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531909/56debed9d7d4450ae880e74fde3fb50e0aabffbc.png[/img]

[b]We are feeling immense pressure mixed with joy and excitement to showcase our game for the first time to a wider audience at Gamescom and to our peers in the gaming industry.[/b]

This game started life as a VR arcade game, but through expansion of scope and time, we have been able to evolve it past our initial limitation of an arcade game and into a reflection of some of our favorite games, but in a VR space. Working with such a talented team, we have been able to achieve so much in such a short time. We have had to make many hard pivots in development. For example, our initial gameplay focus was on turret-style mounted gun combat, but through testing, we found that free-held weapons were just more fun and opened up our level design and gameplay possibilities. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531909/d1f9d433055aaa03c6eec5de7101552293a38556.png[/img]

Time is your enemy in game development. We struggled most with streamlining our bosses into a unified system while also making each of them a unique fight. Each one of our bosses has attacks that can be mitigated via attacking the weapon directly or an external mitigator. Some weapon systems can always be damaged or have damaged windows. Each one of our bosses has damageable components that can disable their weapons, and the bosses are able to cycle through available weapon systems to find ways to still attack the player. Though each boss follows these rules, we challenged ourselves with their designs to give the player a wholly unique experience with each encounter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531909/76400e96e7ac9766aa13d5ee701a30d2911a03d1.png[/img]

The most enjoyable part of development is the opportunity to work alongside close friends day in and day out on one unified vision and seeing the game take shape and evolve as new systems get implemented and art is finalized.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531909/22be712a9fca9f843ac9fca7b06ee766befc72d4.png[/img]

Participating in Gamescom means a lot to us as a personal dream and a lot on the development side of things to set aside time and manpower to ensure that a build is polished and ready to go for the show. A great mix of stress, anxiety, and excitement all wrapped up into one event.
